newsitem.title: USA: Sen Roth - Changes in CPI needs Clinton leadership.
newsitem.headline: Sen Roth - Changes in CPI needs Clinton leadership.

text.p: Senate Finance Committee Chairman William Roth Wednesday said that any reform in the way the Consumer Price Index is calculated will require bipartisan effort, including leadership from President Clinton.

Roth, who spoke at a press briefing to unveil a report by a private advisory commission on the CPI, said he hoped the Bureau of Labor Statistics would not only consider the recommendations by the Boskin Commission, but act on them as quickly as possible.
"I want to stress that any action we take on this report must be broadly and deeply bipartisan," the Delaware Republican said.
"We must also have the full cooperation and leadership by the Clinton administration," he said, adding "clearly this reform will not be successful without the President's leadership."
He said he intended to hold a hearings on the commission report early next year.
